nodes.rationale: adult, aloi, california_housing, covtype, epsilon, helena, higgs_small, jannis, microsoft, yahoo, year — N_{train,val,test}.npy naming (vs the other archive's X_num_*), plus q_* files for the ranking datasets. All five benchmarks_rtdl.py datasets come from this ONE archive so the published comparison table is internally consistent; ALOI/Helena/Epsilon/Yahoo/Microsoft sit here unextracted.
